Surface contours axis objects

Source: R/zz-gen-shared.R
go_surface_contours_axis.Rd

Used for x, y, z in 3 places in the schema. go_surface_contours_axis() creates one; a named list with the same properties works too.

Usage

go_surface_contours_axis(
  ...,
  color = NULL,
  end = NULL,
  highlight = NULL,
  highlightcolor = NULL,
  highlightwidth = NULL,
  project = NULL,
  show = NULL,
  size = NULL,
  start = NULL,
  usecolormap = NULL,
  width = NULL,
  skip_invalid = FALSE
)

Arguments

...

Not for properties, which must be named in full: an abbreviated or unknown name is an error that suggests the right one.

color

Sets the color of the contour lines. Color: a CSS color string or R color name.

end

Sets the end contour level value. Must be more than `contours.start` Number.

highlight

Determines whether or not contour lines about the x dimension are highlighted on hover. Logical.

highlightcolor

Sets the color of the highlighted contour lines. Color: a CSS color string or R color name.

highlightwidth

Sets the width of the highlighted contour lines. Number in the interval [1, 16].

project

A go_project() object or named list, with properties x, y and z (see go_project()).

show

Determines whether or not contour lines about the x dimension are drawn. Logical.

size

Sets the step between each contour level. Must be positive. Number in the interval [0, Inf].

start

Sets the starting contour level value. Must be less than `contours.end` Number.

usecolormap

An alternate to "color". Determines whether or not the contour lines are colored using the trace "colorscale". Logical.

width

Sets the width of the contour lines. Number in the interval [1, 16].

skip_invalid

If TRUE, silently drop invalid properties instead of raising an error.

Value

A go_surface_contours_axis object (a named list).

Details

These objects appear in 3 places in the plotly.js schema (properties named x, y, z), all with the same properties and rules.

Examples

go_figure() |>
  add_surface(
    z = volcano,
    contours = go_surface_contours(
      x = go_surface_contours_axis(color = "red")
    )
  )
